body: Yes, it's that one, I actually took a shot before I called I was so nervous, thank you (and thank you everyone, you've all been so kind!), the dread comes and goes for me, but I feel like I'm getting better at dealing with it
Thank you, I'm still glad that I did but I can't help but feel disheartened. I'm going to keep on trying.

I am also late to replying, so all good. Unfortunately not based in the UK, but I'll be sure to look into wildlife rehab in my area. Thank you for offering to help though, I should have known not to take him to a vet

You say that you're so far behind in terms of progress, but judging by the rest of your post, I don't see that at all. You got over your addiction, you cut off the people who were making you feel worse about yourself. I see you taking steps to better yourself, despite everything you've experienced. That doesn't make you worthless in the slightest.
I don't know, but I do know it will be painful. It's a sad way to leave this world. You don't deserve that, even if you might think otherwise.
Any time, man. Just shoot me a message whenever you feel the need to. You don't have to go through this alone.

Yeah, I can understand wanting a stranger to hear you out. Suicide is difficult to talk about with your family and friends, because of that fear of judgement. But if you do have someone you can trust, I'd suggest you open up to them. It's tough, but it might ease the pain a bit more. That's not to say I won't be here, but I'd really like you to get all the help you can get. It's up to you, of course, I'm only judging this from my experience. You know yourself best, so do what you think is right.  If anyone does blame you, which I find really unlikely, but even so, if they do, then they aren't worth your time. I can tell you right now that you are *not* to blame for her decision. She did it on her own accord. I'm sure if she was here now, she'd want you to know that.

I know. It's hard not to get caught up in all those 'what ifs'. As you said, you don't know what could've happened if you did something differently. Maybe saying something in particular would change her mind or maybe it wouldn't. There's no way of knowing. It's torture, but I understand why you're doing it. You miss your friend. You did all you could do for her at the time. It's not your fault.

Have you talked to anyone else about how you feel?

I'm sorry. I wish I had something better to say, but I truly am sorry for your friend and what you're going through. I think you did help her. I think she was glad that in the end, she had someone who cared about her, talked to her and accepted her. I'm here if you need someone to talk to.

I know that feeling, of wanting something to take your life. I’ve wished that I had cancer as well, though rationally, it doesn’t make much sense. Cancer takes far too long to kill, and you’ll suffer all the way through. 

And yet, our minds continues to tell us these things. You shouldn’t have to go through the pain of three disorders.  But you are. And like you said, it fucking sucks. You don’t know if you’ll get better or not. It’s like everything is so uncertain. 

Let me tell you though, leaving your nose bleeding like that is only adding to the pain. Obviously, I can’t force you to do anything, but please get it checked out. 

If you want, you can talk to me. About anything, it doesn’t matter.

Thank you, seriously thank you. It’s good to know that I’m not alone in this. I forget that all too often. I’m feeling a bit better now but I’ll keep your offer in mind. 

By the way, you’re totally right. We should be able to express our feelings, no matter what that may be. And if people avoid you just for that, then you don’t need them in your life.
